instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: Aftercare Threadboard tracks and coordinates follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge. Ward Coordinators record care-team actions, Care Coordinators assign them to clinic teams and track open or done status, Clinic Team Members add completion notes before marking actions done, and Patient Liaisons record patient contact details and responses when participation is required. The full action-type list and available patient-contact channels remain undecided. The existing discharge-summary process is not replaced.

output.summary: Aftercare Threadboard tracks and coordinates follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge. Ward Coordinators, Care Coordinators, Clinic Team Members, and Patient Liaisons record, assign, track, complete, and document applicable patient-contact activities. The full list of action types and the available patient-contact channels remain unresolved, and the existing discharge-summary process is not replaced.
output.primary_goal: Track and coordinate follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge.

Assign follow-up actions to clinic teams
Track whether actions are open or done
Add completion notes before marking actions done
Record patient contact details and responses for applicable actions

The available patient-contact channels are undecided.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Kickoff notes: The project is Aftercare Threadboard, with the objective of tracking and coordinating follow-up actions created when a patient is cleared for discharge. The Ward Coordinator records actions listed by the care team. The Care Coordinator assigns each action to a clinic team and tracks whether it is open or done. A Clinic Team Member adds a completion note before marking an assigned action done. The Patient Liaison records patient contact details and responses when an action requires patient participation. Managing the discharge summary is excluded because it remains in the existing records process. The action-type list and patient-contact channels are still unspecified.
